ud4.5:6.3: Mv.X.4.6-7 places the story of the elephant’s service to the Buddha in the context of the quarrel at Kosambī, but the details of how the Buddha left Kosambī given in Mv.X.3 are different.
ud4.5:8.2: Great one = nāga. This term can mean magical serpent or large elephant, and is often used as an epithet for an arahant.
